name: Peru
description: The Sacred Valley and the Inca Trail, timed and paced by a guide who knows the altitude better than the map does — ending, on the fourth morning, at the Sun Gate.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~8hr direct from the US, then a domestic flight to Cusco
quickFacts.climate: Varies hugely by altitude — warm coast, cold highlands

topExperiences: Sunrise at Machu Picchu's Sun Gate
